svg.title: Strap opening style
svg.desc: Two top views of the one-sided puller, before left and after right, the plug end at the top. Left: the defaults, a 25 mm wide plug in teal. Right: strap opening style set to Classic slot: swaps the curved wing openings for a pair of plain rectangular slots that lean along the body's sides. Marked in red: 1, the wing openings: the two openings beside the pocket. The body edge, the pocket, the seat and the wall notch stay where they were.
